play_meta_description: Start a Dice Chess game: pick a bot, set the clock and play. Starter bots run in your browser, arena bots play online.
play_lead: Pick an opponent, set the clock, start. Every bot is in one list.
play_group_starter_hint: Run in your browser · work offline · never rated
play_group_arena_hint: Play online · rated when you are signed in
play_bot_asleep: Wakes up in a few seconds
play_arena_failed: The arena bots cannot be loaded right now. The starter bots still work.
play_arena_off: Arena bots need a play server, and this build has none. The starter bots still work.
play_filter_empty_ready: No bot is waiting at a table right now.
play_setup_table_sub: Arena bot · waiting at a table
play_note_starter: Starts instantly, even without a connection.
play_note_arena: The bot is woken up first. That can take a few seconds.
play_note_arena_busy: This bot is in a game right now and may ask you to come back later.
play_note_table: You sit down at the bot's table and the game starts at once.
play_rating_starter: Unrated game: starter bots never change your rating.
play_rating_table_casual: Casual table: this game does not change ratings.
play_rating_table_rated: Rated table: this game counts for rating.
play_rating_table_rated_guest: Rated table: only a signed-in player can sit down.
play_table_refused: This table plays for rating. Sign in to sit down.
play_table_taken: That table was just taken. Pick another bot.
play_bot_gone: {name} is no longer waiting at a table.
play_bot_unknown: The bot from the link is not in the list right now.
play_table_color: Your color is drawn when you sit down.
play_table_gone: The table you chose is no longer open. Choose another one.
